email.subject1: a signal play for dbt Labs
email.body1:
Matt, saw dbt Labs picked up a 2026 Google Cloud Partner of the Year award and shipped dbt Copilot.

On the sales-strategy side, that kind of win usually creates more in-market accounts than the team can cover before the moment passes, and that overflow is pipeline lost. Our AI SDR researches, writes, and follows up autonomously, so coverage scales without new headcount: 3-5x more meetings per rep.

I built a personalized signal play for dbt Labs off your hiring and tech-stack signals, and accounts showing them tend to progress ~4.4x faster. Worth 15 minutes for me to walk you through it?
email.body2:
Matt, quick follow-up for dbt Labs.

Strategy work usually exposes the coverage gap before the team can close it, since most don't know how many meetings it actually takes to hit the number. So it surfaces late and turns the quarter into a scramble.

Want to grab 15 minutes? I'll walk you through our pipeline model and show exactly how many meetings dbt Labs needs to hit target this quarter, and where the math breaks if you only add reps.
email.body3:
Matt, last bit of proof for dbt Labs.

Memgraph had more in-market accounts than the team could touch and couldn't hire SDRs fast enough. They ran our AI SDR to $2.7M in pipeline, 600 replies, and 60 BANT-qualified deals in 90 days, same team, live in four weeks with every email auto-logged to their CRM.

I pulled a benchmark of how dbt Labs' reply rate likely compares to other data-platform teams. Want to hop on a quick call and I'll walk you through it?
email.body4:
Matt, I'll stop reaching out on this one, but didn't want to leave you empty-handed.

If scaling pipeline without adding headcount isn't a priority this quarter, no problem at all. Planning around a new launch is its own kind of busy, and I know timing matters.

Before I close your file, worth 15 minutes to walk through a one-page playbook of three AI-SDR plays scoped to a data-platform sales motion? I'll tailor it to dbt Labs either way.
